sources.title: PayPal lays off 70 employees in Israel
sources.description: This nearly 25% cut in the Israel office of the payment services giant is part of a global streamlining process.

sources.title: PayPal adds another round of layoffs as part of multiyear restructuring plan | Honolulu Star-Advertiser
sources.description: PayPal, the digital payments company, is laying off 251 employees at its San José headquarters in another round of layoffs, according to a recent government filing.

sources.title: PayPal says it's 'becoming a technology company again' — that means AI | TechCrunch
sources.description: PayPal is pitching an AI-led turnaround, tying automation and restructuring to $1.5 billion in savings as it cuts jobs and works to modernize its tech stack.
